snippet.title: Cute & Dead - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dear friends! We present to you a new VR game from Deep Type Games studio. Cute & Dead is a fast-paced arcade zombie shooter with elements of collecting and dating simulation. Cute & Dead combines gameplay elements of classic Sega games with modern VR technologies. We are very much looking forward to your support and plan to release our game this summer on Meta Quest and Steam.
More info: https://www.meta.com/experiences/cute-dead/25169686829339625/
